class.name: OcgAspectDisplayconnection
class.brief_description: This class creates and provides connection with X server. Raises exception if can not connect to X server. On Windows and Mac OS X (in case when Cocoa used) platforms this class does nothing. WARNING: Do not close display connection manually!
class.description: ! This class creates and provides connection with X server. ! Raises exception if can not connect to X server. ! On Windows and Mac OS X (in case when Cocoa used) platforms this class does nothing. ! WARNING: Do not close display connection manually!

method.name: default
method.description: Default constructor. Creates connection with display name taken from "DISPLAY" environment variable

method.name: IsOwnDisplay
method.description: Returns TRUE if X Display has been allocated by this class
